tools.name: list_public_holidays
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what the public holidays are in a country or region for a given year, when a particular holiday falls, or how many holidays a year has. Covers 200+ countries with state and province detail. Do not use it for working-day arithmetic; use add_business_days for that.

tools.name: check_business_day
tools.description: Use this when the user asks whether one specific date is a working day, a public holiday, or whether businesses and banks are open. Names the holiday if there is one, and reports whether independent holiday sources agree on that date.

tools.name: add_business_days
tools.description: Use this when the user needs a date N working days from another date: delivery and shipping estimates, payment or settlement terms, notice periods, SLA and deadline questions. Skips weekends and the public holidays of the country or region, reports exactly which days were skipped, and flags any date

tools.name: cross_check_holidays
tools.description: Use this when accuracy matters more than speed, or when the user questions whether a holiday date is right: contracts, payroll, settlement, compliance deadlines.
